name: First Steps
controllingIdea: The first home purchase is a rite of passage that changes a person's relationship with the world.

narrativeArc.incitingIncident: Client realizes renting is no longer working - the decision to buy
narrativeArc.risingAction: Education phase, overcoming fear, myths, and self-doubt
narrativeArc.crisis: The 'can we really do this?' moment of hesitation
narrativeArc.climax: Finding THE one and committing - the leap of faith
narrativeArc.resolution: Keys in hand, identity transformed, new chapter begins

questions.question: Tell us about your first-time buyer - where were they starting from?
questions.purpose: Establish the starting point and relatability
questions.placeholder: They were paying $2,800 in rent and thought homeownership was out of reach...

questions.question: What fears or misconceptions did they have about buying?
questions.purpose: Build relatability for other first-time buyers
questions.placeholder: They thought they needed 20% down and perfect credit...

questions.question: What was their biggest 'aha moment' in the process?
questions.placeholder: When they realized their mortgage payment would be less than rent...

questions.question: How did it feel when they got the keys?
questions.placeholder: She cried. He couldn't stop smiling. Their dog ran through every room...

questions.question: What would you tell other renters who are hesitating?
questions.placeholder: Stop paying someone else's mortgage. You're probably more ready than you think...

promptConfig.systemContext: This is a coming-of-age story. A first-time buyer overcomes fear and achieves homeownership. Focus on the emotional transformation and make it relatable to other renters.
promptConfig.toneGuidance: Encouraging, warm, and celebratory. Speak directly to other renters who are hesitating. Make homeownership feel achievable.

slideStructure.contentFocus: The transformation from renter to owner

usageHints: Perfect for attracting more first-time buyer clients
Address specific misconceptions (down payment, credit, etc.)
The emotional moment is the highlight
End with encouragement for others in similar situations

exampleScenarios.title: From $2,500 Rent to First Home
exampleScenarios.situation: Couple thought they couldn't afford to buy, discovered they were wrong
exampleScenarios.sampleInput: This couple was paying $2,500/month in rent and thought they needed $100k saved to buy. I showed them FHA options and they got into their first home with just $15k down. Their mortgage is $2,200.

expectedOutput.keyMoment: Their mortgage is $300 less than their old rent.
